stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig and Miss Rabbit watch the children play in the soft play maze
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Place/Fun): 'Where are Mummy Pig and Miss Rabbit?' (Prompt: At the soft play center / At the supermarket) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'At the soft play center!'
Q2 (Observation/Colors): 'Look at the ball pit! What colorful toys are the children jumping in?' (Prompt: Lots of colorful plastic balls / Water) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'In the colorful balls!'
Q3 (Characters): 'Can you spot Richard Rabbit sliding down the rope?' (Prompt: Yes / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, Richard Rabbit is sliding!'

stopPoints.label: Mr. Elephant volunteers to climb inside to help the stuck grown-ups
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Who/Animal): 'Who came into the ball pit wearing a red bow tie?' (Prompt: Mr. Elephant / Daddy Pig) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Mr. Elephant!'
Q2 (Action/Problem): 'The mothers are stuck! What does Mr. Elephant say he will do?' (Prompt: Help them get out / Eat some cake) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He wants to rescue them!'
Q3 (Observation/Face): 'Look at Mr. Elephant's big trunk. What animal is he?' (Prompt: A big elephant / A tiger) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He is an elephant!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig and Miss Rabbit get stuck in the climbing tunnels
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Funny/Plot): 'Oh no! What happened to Daddy Pig and Miss Rabbit inside the tunnel?' (Prompt: They got stuck / They are dancing) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'They are stuck!'
Q2 (Tool/Action): 'Look at Daddy Pig's hand! What is he holding to call for help?' (Prompt: A walkie-talkie / phone / A spoon) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He is holding a phone!'
Q3 (Observation): 'Miss Rabbit is upside down! Are her ears pointing down?' (Prompt: Yes, upside down / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, she is upside down!'

stopPoints.label: The grown-ups are rescued and stand outside the play area together
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Rescue/Hero): 'Who went into the small tunnels to rescue the grown-ups?' (Prompt: Peppa and Suzy Sheep / The fire truck) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Peppa and Suzy!'
Q2 (Feelings): 'Everyone is out of the tunnels now! Are the parents happy and smiling?' (Prompt: Yes, smiling / No, crying) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, they are happy!'
Q3 (Next/Story): 'Daddy says it is time to go home, but where did the little children go?' (Prompt: Back inside to play / To sleep) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Back inside to play!'
